    UK coastline in ETRS89 / LAEA Europe (EPSG:3035)

    uk_coast_3035.Rd

    A simple-feature (sf) object containing the coastline of the United Kingdom extracted from the CEF coastline dataset and reprojected to ETRS89 / LAEA Europe (EPSG:3035).

    Usage

    uk_coast_3035

    Format

    An sf object containing coastline geometries for the United Kingdom.

    Source

    Derived from the built-in cef_coast_3035 coastline dataset.

    Details

    The dataset is primarily intended for plotting and spatial operations involving seabORD example rasters and model inputs, which are supplied in the same projected coordinate reference system.

    The dataset was derived from the built-in cef_coast_3035 coastline dataset by selecting features where COUNTRY == "United Kingdom" and retaining the geometry in the ETRS89 / LAEA Europe projection (EPSG:3035).

    The dataset can be used to provide geographical context when plotting seabORD spatial inputs and outputs, including:

    • seamasks

    • bird distribution maps (BrdData)

    • competition distribution maps (FrgCompData)

    • flight-distance rasters

    • offshore renewable development (ORD) footprints

    Examples

    # Load the coastline
data("uk_coast_3035", package = "seabORD")

# Inspect the object
uk_coast_3035
#> Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 2 fields
#> Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 3152007 ymin: 3095478 xmax: 3763415 ymax: 4239476
#> Projected CRS: +proj=laea +lat_0=52 +lon_0=10 +x_0=4321000 +y_0=3210000 +ellps=GRS80 +units=m +no_defs
#>          COUNTRY ID_0                       geometry
#> 1 United Kingdom  GBR MULTIPOLYGON (((3296703 357...

# Plot the coastline
plot(sf::st_geometry(uk_coast_3035))
